input.narration: Thessaly thrusts out an ink-stained hand and looses a bead of flame at the ogre.
The flame splashes across the ogre's hide; it bellows and stays on its feet.
Sister Ilda raises her holy symbol; pale radiance gathers around it and lances toward the ogre.
The bolt of radiance sears past the ogre and bursts against the mill timbers, leaving the brute unmarked.
Brannis steps in hard, planting himself between the ogre and Thessaly with his greatsword coming up.
He drives the blade at the ogre with both hands.
Steel bites into the ogre, drawing a furious roar as Brannis holds the line.
The ogre snarls down at the warrior blocking its path and brings its greatclub crashing toward Brannis.
The club slams home, but Brannis remains standing in front of Thessaly.
Thessaly flicks a pinch of butter-yellow arcane paste toward the ogre's feet; the mill floor there blooms into a slick black sheen.
Thessaly flicks a pinch of butter-yellow arcane paste toward the ogre's feet; the mill floor there blooms into a slick black sheen.
Brannis keeps his footing at the slick's edge, but the ogre's heel skids out from under it and the giant crashes prone onto the greasy mill floor.
Sister Ilda hurries across the mill floor toward Brannis, keeping her shield up as she reaches his side.
Seeing Brannis bearing the worst wounds, Ilda speaks a bright, ringing prayer over the din of the mill.
At arm's length in the lantern-lit mill, Ilda has Brannis clearly in sight.
Seeing Brannis bearing the worst wounds, Ilda speaks a bright, ringing prayer over the din of the mill.
Warm light closes Brannis's bruises as Ilda steadies beside him.
Brannis backs away from the sprawled ogre, giving himself room to hurl a javelin.
As Brannis turns to fall back, the prone ogre lashes out with its greatclub from the greasy floor.
Staggering from the parting blow, Brannis snaps a javelin overhand at the fallen ogre.
The ogre's desperate swing catches Brannis as he withdraws, but his javelin still punches into the prone brute.
The ogre heaves itself up from the slick floor and lurches toward Sister Ilda, club dragging through the grease.
Still low amid the slick boards, the ogre swings its greatclub in a brutal sweep at Sister Ilda.
The ogre wallows in the grease and sweeps its greatclub at Ilda, but her shield turns the blow aside.
Thessaly retreats across the mill floor, putting more space between herself and the greasy, fallen ogre.
Thessaly backs toward the mill wall, putting as much safe distance as the cramped room allows between herself and the ogre.
From near the wall, Thessaly snaps another ember-bright fire bolt toward the prone ogre.
The shot goes wide, hissing into the greasy boards beside the ogre rather than striking true.

input.label: shoulder the prone ogre into the turning millstone
input.narration: Ilda lowers her shield-side shoulder and drives into the prone ogre, trying to skid its bulk across the greasy boards toward the churning millstone.
Ilda's shove catches the ogre while the grease is under it; the brute slides hard into the turning millstone.
The stone grinds into the ogre's shoulder and ribs with a wet, heavy crunch.
Ilda's bold charge pays off: the ogre is shoved into the great millstone and left battered on the slick floor.

input.label: swing the hoist rope grain sack into the ogre
input.narration: Brannis seizes the hoist rope, boots off the millstone housing, and hauls the hanging grain sack into a heavy pendulum arc toward the prone ogre.

input.ruling: swinging grain sack on the hoist rope
input.narration: The loaded sack comes whipping through the bottom of the arc and slams into the ogre's side.
The sack smashes into the ogre with a dusty thud, leaving it battered but still moving beside the millstone.
Battered and slick with grease, the ogre drags itself closer to Sister Ilda, murder in its eyes.
The prone ogre swings upward in a vicious, two-handed arc at Ilda.
The club catches Ilda hard despite the ogre's awkward position, driving the air from her and leaving her badly hurt.
Thessaly keeps her distance and hurls another spark of focused flame at the prone ogre.
This time the fire bolt clips the ogre across the back, burning through grime and grease as it writhes beside the millstone.
Ilda raises her holy symbol despite her wounds, calling a column of holy fire down onto the ogre beside her.
The ogre is right in front of Ilda, huge and plainly visible in the mill's dim light.
Ilda raises her holy symbol despite her wounds, calling a column of holy fire down onto the ogre beside her.
Radiance flares around the ogre, but it twists aside just enough that the sacred flame gutters out without searing it.
Brannis rushes back in across the mill floor, greatsword low as he closes on the ogre's exposed leg.
As Brannis steps into the slick, his boots skid on Thessaly's grease.
Brannis hits the slick boards but keeps his grip; from the floor he hacks his greatsword toward the ogre's knee.
The grease betrays Brannis; he sprawls beside the ogre, and his low cut skids short of the brute's knee.
Bleeding and furious on the slick floor, the ogre focuses on the wounded priestess and hammers its greatclub toward Ilda.
The greatclub breaks through Ilda's guard and drops her hard onto the greasy boards, unconscious at the ogre's feet.
